manifest.description: Diagnose a conceptual Java responsibility scattered across units with no canonical owner.
when_to_use: one policy, formatting rule, validation rule, or workflow appears in several Java services, UI paths, adapters, or imports
static overlap is visible but the conceptual responsibility and canonical owner require semantic judgment
a correction plan needs migration order for consolidating scattered behavior
anti_patterns: do not use for lexical clones a clone detector can classify
do not use for broad package metrics without a named responsibility
do not use on non-Java targets
